authoring.language_policy: Natural English scene descriptions. Preserve exact readable Vietnamese/English strings for literal/mixed. Mark English or English+Vietnamese per query. Visual transcription by this assistant, no independent human verification; small compressed broadcast text may be ambiguous. Source image grounding does not prove upstream OCR byte provenance.

selection_rule.assigned_kinds: literal, scene, mixed repeated in selected-video then selected-image order, before viewing
selection_rule.dev_reference: benchmarks/l04_ocr_exploratory_20261111.json; eight frozen single-positive queries, never edited; no tuning
selection_rule.fallback: If reliable exact on-screen text cannot be read for a literal/mixed assignment, use scene on the SAME image and record reason; no substitution
selection_rule.image_order: canonical numeric .jpg stems sorted numerically, distinct identities
selection_rule.no_reuse: Exclude every prior target video, prior judged numeric identity and exact query string. Neighborhoods must not overlap; fail before authoring, never content-reselect.
selection_rule.target_indices_zero_based: floor((image_count-1)/3), floor(2*(image_count-1)/3); require both in [2,image_count-3] and distinct
selection_rule.video_order: sorted canonical L04_V[0-9]{3} directory names under dataset/data/L04 only

sequence: Protocol, identical scoring and 18 targets / 90 disjoint window identities frozen before image viewing.
All 90 original images opened directly via functions.read, no caption/OCR payload or ranks viewed.
Explicit whole-query judgments authored from images; t10 literal-to-scene fallback on same image.
Packet frozen and SHA printed before corpus loading, ranking or metrics; no subsequent query/label/weight tuning.
authoring.source_grounding: Assistant-authored visual transcriptions and relevance labels, not independently human-verified; uninspected frames UNJUDGED. Ticker/scene conjunctions do not assert shared event truth.
